title: Section 760.32 – Revise the Informational Note in Section 760.32 to read as follows:
officialText:
Informational Note: An example of a protective device suitable to provide protection is a device tested to the
requirements of ANSI/UL 497B, Standard for Protectors for Data Communications and Fire Alarm Circuits.
